 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Replace each isolated marker with a copy of the embedded horizontal pattern."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    # The dense horizontal object is the template; remaining non-background cells are markers.
    by_row = {}
    for r, c in points:
        by_row.setdefault(r, []).append(c)
    template_row = max(by_row, key=lambda r: len(by_row[r]))
    cols = by_row[template_row]
    left, right = min(cols), max(cols)
    pattern = g[template_row][left:right + 1]
    marker_value = next((g[r][c] for r, c in points if r != template_row), None)
    markers = [(r, c) for r, c in points if r != template_row and g[r][c] == marker_value]
    for r, c in markers:
        start = c - len(pattern) // 2
        for i, value in enumerate(pattern):
            if 0 <= start + i < len(g[0]):
                g[r][start + i] = value
    return g
"
